Benjamin Marsh

A rogue operative named by Compromised as part of the Gulf Coast network tied to Keener associates.

Connectionnot applicable Continuitydivision transmedia Canon scopeofficial transmedia Verificationsource reviewed Reviewed2026-07-27

Rogue-network link

Marsh is the novel's named link between the Gulf Coast operation and a known-associates list containing Keener, Kajika and Parnell. The record does not infer a broader hierarchy beyond that listed association. [1]

Marsh Island betrayal

The arms rendezvous ends with Marsh turning on the Reborn and then dying in the same confrontation, exposing the network's use of the faction. [1]

Claim ledger

Every factual statement below must retain at least one traceable source.

  1. confirmed

    Compromised has ISAC identify Benjamin Marsh as a rogue agent during the Marsh Island arms rendezvous. [1]

  2. confirmed

    The novel's ISAC identification lists Aaron Keener, Javier Kajika and Theo Parnell as Benjamin Marsh's known associates. [1]

  3. confirmed

    Marsh is killed during the Marsh Island rendezvous after betraying Cassandra Raines and the Reborn operatives present there. [1]
